Ingredients                         Directions

lengthwise and seeded               sheet with cooking spray.
1 (8 ounce) package cream
cheese, softened                    Fill each jalapeno half with cream cheese. Wrap 1 bacon strip
1 (5.25 ounce) package frozen       around each jalapeno half and secure with a toothpick. Arrange
vegetarian bacon strips, thawed     wrapped jalapenos on baking sheet.
toothpicks

                                  Corn with Bacon and Chili Powder
Ingredients                       Directions
4 ears corn, husked and cleaned   Wash the husked corn.
4 slices bacon
